observations.name: home
observations.observed: Fresh browser: actual sample sensor, mission/lab links and no invented Resume.

observations.name: credits-dialog
observations.observed: Credits opens a named modal with original artwork/fonts and license source.

observations.name: shortcuts-dialog
observations.observed: Keyboard help lists implemented keyboard behavior; Escape closes.

observations.name: onboarding-mode
observations.observed: Three learning modes; initial Back disabled with a reason.

observations.name: onboarding-alias
observations.observed: Synthetic nickname entered; shuffle and local-storage scope visible.

observations.name: onboarding-destination
observations.observed: Nickname saved; mission/lab/team choices and optional tutorial available.

observations.name: mission-predict
observations.observed: M01 prediction before any result is revealed; code, physical stage and inspector.

observations.name: mission-briefing
observations.observed: Narrative, objective, vocabulary, success scenarios and teacher-note disclosure.

observations.name: mission-compare-probe
observations.observed: Actual24<20 false; wrong prediction opens tentative adaptive investigation.

observations.name: mission-running
observations.observed: Replay schedules preserved physical snapshots; Run is replaced by Pause.

observations.name: probe-rationale
observations.observed: Probe rationale lists competing ideas and their executed predictions.

observations.name: counterexample-predict
observations.observed: Verified generated single-change experiment; changed result withheld before prediction.

observations.name: counterexample-result
observations.observed: Real changed run and baseline comparison are revealed after locked prediction.

observations.name: reassessment
observations.observed: Different scenario; actual transfer result, completion checklist and next-activity reason.

observations.name: evidence-timeline
observations.observed: Mission, probe, experiment and transfer records remain inspectable.

observations.name: progress
observations.observed: Real local synthetic attempt and evidence; no fabricated learner outcomes.

observations.name: instructor
observations.observed: Actual browser-local report, filters, assignments, export and scoped deletion.

observations.name: mission-library
observations.observed: Eight real authored missions with metadata, state, prerequisites and real recommendation.

observations.name: mission-preview
observations.observed: Read-only objective/world/vocabulary preview does not create an attempt.

observations.name: free-lab
observations.observed: World controls, same authoritative interpreter, optional prediction mode and recovery.

observations.name: blockly
observations.observed: Real categorized Blockly workspace and inert preview; no claim of natural block dragging.

observations.name: team-setup
observations.observed: Local2–6 aliases, real mission selection and no account or online-presence claim.

observations.name: team-private-handoff
observations.observed: Pass-device screen hides private predictions before Ready.

observations.name: team-role-contribution
observations.observed: Current role records a meaningful observation and separate prediction before handoff.

observations.name: settings
observations.observed: Actual appearance/storage/privacy, bounded data import/export and scoped typed deletion.

observations.name: how-it-works-trace
observations.observed: Explanation includes a genuinely executed sample trace and accurate limits.

observations.name: not-found
observations.observed: Unknown path retains local data and offers both Home and library recovery.
